units.source_text: 此时几个身份较高的侍女，正在玉鬘尚侍面前，向她叙述许多求婚者失望后的痛苦之状。

en.t: At this time, several ladies-in-waiting of higher rank were before Lady Tamakazura, describing to her the suffering of the many suitors after their disappointment.

units.source_text: 就中那个中将说道：“藏人少将说‘生死凭君定’的话，看来不是空言呢，真可怜啊！”

en.t: Among them, that captain said, “When the Minor Captain of the Palace Guards said, ‘My life or death is for you to decide,’ it seems he was not speaking empty words. How pitiful!”
The Naishi no Kami also felt sorry for him.

units.source_text: 因为夕雾右大臣和云居雁夫人亦曾有意，而且藏人少将十分固执，所以尚侍准备至少须将二女公子作代。

en.t: Because Minister of the Right Yugiri and Lady Kumoinokari had also once favored the idea, and because the Minor Captain of the Palace Guards was so obstinate, the Naishi no Kami was prepared at least to offer her second daughter in place of the elder one.

units.source_text: 但念此人妨碍大女公子入院，实甚不该。

en.t: Yet when she thought that this man had obstructed the elder daughter’s entry into the Retired Emperor’s palace, she felt it had been truly improper.

units.source_text: 况且髭黑大臣在世之时早有预定：大女公子决不嫁与臣下，无论其人地位何等高贵。

en.t: Moreover, while Minister Higekuro was still alive, he had already resolved that the elder daughter would never be married to a subject, no matter how exalted that man’s rank might be.

units.source_text: 如今入冷泉院，犹嫌前程有限呢。

en.t: Even now, entering Retired Emperor Reizei’s household still seemed to leave her prospects somewhat limited.

units.source_text: 在这时候侍女送进藏人少将的信来，实在没意思了。

en.t: At just such a time, a lady-in-waiting brought in a letter from the Minor Captain of the Palace Guards, which was really tiresome.
The captain then replied to him with a poem:
